寒冬哨兵.normal: 1. Group up to drop the wind, then drag it away; interrupt the add and soak the big white circle. || 2. On full-screen AoE, group and stand in the white circle/snow pile to resist knockback. || Tank: keep the boss near the white circle left by the dead add.
